unscoredIds.reason: 2026-10-13 neural-network solution of spin-polarized electrons at nu=3/2 reports a ground-state manifold with quantum dimension sqrt(2) and favors the anti-Pfaffian. Ising anyons, not an S3 braid. Score next only if a braid interferometer is the result.

2026-10-13 BB-Net predicts bivariate-bicycle distances. The abstract states 96.39 percent accuracy on reference distances and 98.94 percent on a certified subset. A predictor is not a code. Score next only if a certified distance tightens a tracked family.

2026-10-08 PINN flow-map method. Vlasov-Poisson is one of four test equations, with advection, Euler, and drift-kinetic. Not a fusion rate. Score next only if the method is used on a DT rate with the ledger terms.
2026-10-12 theory of quasistatic dephasing for two coupled Kitaev chains, following a cited parity-qubit experiment. E-MZM stays WATCH. Score next only if independent X and Z logicals are measured.
2026-10-13 graphene quantum Hall dot reports e/3 backscattering and an anyon binding energy. Abelian fractional charge. Score next only if non-Abelian statistics are measured.

2026-10-13 repetition-code bit flips on a driven disordered Ising model, distances 3 and 5, up to 68 qubits, memory time up to about twice the bare decay. Not a surface code or qLDPC code. E-TC stays CUT. Score next only if the memory is a surface code.
2026-10-14 Kitaev honeycomb ribbons. Majorana edge modes change Kibble-Zurek defect production in a simulator benchmark. Not a wire device. Score next only if a parity logical is measured.
2026-10-14 anyon-impurity binding in twisted MoTe2, fractional-charge ratio near 5/3 at nu=-2/3 and -3/5. Not a braid. Score next only if braiding is measured.
